scope: Futures live order and margin/liquidation/ADL notifications; notification center remains partial pending Spot and deposit/withdrawal sources.
native_testing: Skipped at user request. No device tools, APK installation, actual mobile storage/force-kill or wallet event verification. See ../native-verification-pending.md.
ios: Linux lacks macOS/Xcode; build and native flows unverified.
boundaries: Only events received during explicitly authorized live monitoring are collected. Background pauses, expiry and disconnections may leave gaps; no system push or missed-event backfill.
Current wallet lists and already-open details are isolated. No local demo activity is represented as real notifications.

Local best-effort inbox/read state keeps at most 500 recent records and 4 MiB across wallets. Old entries may be evicted. Clearing app data or uninstall loses them; this is not complete exchange history or the durable financial request journal.

Initial read/corruption failures retain stored bytes and buffer live/read changes. Write failures preserve visible memory and expose safe retry. Accepted writes can finish after listeners are disposed.

Critical order events report actual order state and quantities, never infer full-position liquidation. Margin calls retain all supplied positions without invented risk ratios, countdowns or liquidation prices.
Public metadata supplies units; missing metadata is unknown/retryable. Margin-call cw has no asset field, so no currency is invented.
Spot executionReport, transfer history first-load baseline/state notifications and ACCOUNT_UPDATE transfer-history refresh remain unimplemented.

Aster enable-trading/signer acceptance, subaccounts, deposits/withdrawals/transfers, complete valuation, Chase, BBO and Scaled remain outstanding. BAPI statistics and TWAP skipped this phase at user request.
build_notes: Build passed with the existing future-compatibility warning about KGP applied by Privy/Coinbase/package_info plugins.
